questions.stem: A young person with liver disease and a tremor. First metal to think about?
questions.explanation: Wilson disease. Ceruloplasmin is usually low.

questions.stem: A missing corneal ring in suspected Wilson disease:

options.text: Means you skip the slit lamp

questions.explanation: Look with a slit lamp; absence does not exclude liver-only disease.

questions.stem: Basal emphysema in a younger patient plus liver disease. Think:
questions.explanation: The protein is stuck in the liver cell. Stopping smoking is urgent.

questions.stem: Itching, a high alkaline phosphatase, and an antimitochondrial antibody:
Beaded bile ducts and inflammatory bowel disease:
questions.explanation: A rising bilirubin is not always a benign stricture.

questions.stem: Ursodiol is the proven disease-modifying drug for:

options.text: Primary biliary cholangitis, not the same proven fixer in sclerosing disease
Both cholestatic diseases equally, as a rule
Wilson disease as the only treatment

questions.explanation: Do not treat the two cholestatic diseases as the same drug and the same cancer worry.

questions.stem: A low-copper diet alone in Wilson disease is:

options.text: Not sufficient; a chelator or zinc is the treatment
The first treatment of sclerosing cholangitis
A reason to skip the slit lamp

questions.explanation: Diet alone is not the plan.

questions.stem: The lung pattern that should make you check an antitrypsin level is:

options.text: Only apical disease in a very old smoker, with no other clue
Basal emphysema in a younger patient

questions.explanation: Especially with liver disease as well.

questions.stem: If the antimitochondrial antibody is already positive, months of chasing a common-duct stone is:

options.text: The miss; think primary biliary cholangitis
Required before any thought of Wilson disease

questions.explanation: Do not chase a stone for months when the antibody is already positive.

options.text: Wilson disease is copper in a young liver, often with a movement problem.
Alpha-1 antitrypsin hits the bases of the lungs and the liver.
Primary biliary and sclerosing cholangitis are the same drug and the same cancer worry.
Sclerosing cholangitis beads the ducts and follows the bowel.

questions.explanation: Do not treat the two cholestatic diseases as the same.
